title: Secure Bench prospective holdout v4

balance.imbalance_justification: Each 4x4 pairwise table contains 56 pairs, so perfect equality would require 3.5 pairs per cell; the preregistered schedule therefore uses only three or four pairs per cell.

overlap.limitation: Exact hashes and normalized token five-gram Jaccard similarity are reproducible overlap proxies; they do not prove semantic independence.

limitations: This is a frozen examination definition, not a scanner result or score.
No result supports rankings, superiority, production readiness, or complete coverage.
Exact and normalized overlap checks are proxies and cannot prove semantic independence.
Ambiguous, recursive, and unsupported-boundary cases require conservative evidence rather than assumed reachability.
